item.title: Astkles #9861 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)
item.description: Astkles #9861 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
